# Introduction
This report present a graphic and statistical overview of temporal trends and spatial variations within the Swedish National Monitoring Programme for Contaminants in Marine Biota. For a more in depth presentation of the monitoring program (sampling area, collected specimen and contaminants included in the program, sampling and analytical methods) and a discussion of results we refer to the report @Soerensen2025marine and article @Ammar2024.


### Method updates since the publication of @Soerensen2025marine
The sum for PFAS-25 (PFOA-equivalents) is preliminary introduced in the report. It is calculated based on the seven PFAS most important to the total sum (PFOS, PFOA, PFNA, PFDA, PFUnDA, PFDoDA, PFTrDA) accounting for >99% of the total PFOA-equivalent sum. A muscle to liver conversion factor of 13.3, based on 219 fish with paired muscle and liver samples, is used to convert the proposed PFAS-25 EQS from a muscle to liver value.

Several recently added PFAS (e.g. NADONA, FBSA, HFPO-DA) have only been analysed for one or two years and are therefore not included in the report.
